claims.claim: A rock is an aggregate of one or more minerals or a body of undifferentiated mineral matter, while a mineral is a naturally occurring inorganic element or compound with characteristic composition and orderly internal structure.

Rocks may contain minerals, broken crystals, broken rock fragments, shells from once-living animals, or compressed plant material, and their ingredients and grain relationships provide clues to history.
Rocks are broadly divided into igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic types according to how they formed.
Igneous rocks form when molten rock solidifies, and magma composition and cooling rate influence the final igneous rock; slowly cooled intrusive rocks commonly have relatively coarse grains.
Clastic sedimentary rocks are formed from fragments, chemical sedimentary rocks by precipitation of dissolved minerals, and biologic sedimentary rocks from once-living material.
Metamorphic rocks are altered from preexisting igneous, sedimentary, or earlier metamorphic rocks under high heat, pressure, mineral-rich fluids, or combinations of these factors.
Some metamorphic rocks develop foliation when pressure aligns flat or elongate minerals, while nonfoliated metamorphic rocks lack that sheet-like structure.
